spatial_claims.claim: O is the center of the circle; A, B are adjacent vertices of the inscribed regular decagon on the circle; OA = OB = radius = hexagon side (by 4.15)
Angle AOB = theta = 36 degrees (10 central angles sum to 360 degrees); angles OAB = ABO = 2*theta = 72 degrees (isosceles triangle angle sum)
D lies on segment OB between O and B, where the bisector of angle OAB meets OB
Angle decomposition: angle OAB = angle OAD + angle DAB, with angle OAD = angle DAB = theta (ray AD between rays AO and AB)
In triangle OAD: angle AOD = angle OAD = theta, so OD = AD (I.6)
In triangle ADB: angle ADB = angle ABD = 2*theta, so AD = AB (I.6); therefore OD = AD = AB
OD > DB: in triangle ADB, angle ABD = 2*theta > angle BAD = theta, so AD > DB (I.19), and OD = AD
Angle bisector proportion (VI.3): OD : DB = OA : AB; substituting OA = OB and AB = OD gives OB : OD = OD : DB (extreme and mean ratio)
C is on extension of OB beyond B, with BC = BA = OD; point order on line is O-D-B-C
By XIII.5, OC is cut in EMR at B with greater segment OB (hexagon side); OC = hexagon side + decagon side

configuration_map: Points on circle: A, B (adjacent decagon vertices). Center: O. Line OB contains D (between O and B) and C (beyond B). Order on line: O --- D --- B --- C. Distances: OA = OB = radius = hexagon side; OD = AD = AB = decagon side; DB = OB - OD (lesser segment); BC = OD = decagon side; OC = OB + BC = hexagon side + decagon side. Triangle OAB is isosceles (OA = OB) with angles theta, 2*theta, 2*theta where theta = 36 degrees. D is where the bisector of angle OAB meets OB. Triangle OAD is isosceles (OD = AD). Triangle ADB is isosceles (AD = AB).
pass_reason: All spatial claims are mutually consistent. The single angle decomposition (bisection of angle OAB) has the middle ray AD properly between the outer rays AO and AB since D lies between O and B on segment OB. All applications of propositions (I.5, I.6, I.19, VI.3, XIII.5) have their spatial hypotheses satisfied. No inside/outside contradictions or betweenness violations exist. Numerical verification confirms OB : OD = OD : DB = phi (golden ratio) and OC : OB = OB : BC = phi.
